   614	## Key Observations
   615	
   616	### File Structure Consistency Across Languages:
   617	- **Core Fields**: guid (string), name (string), createdAt, updatedAt
   618	- **Optional Fields**: remote (URL), size, hash, mime type, description, folder reference
   619	- **Relationships**: Files belong to a single Kit and optionally to a Folder
   620	
   621	### Folder Structure Consistency:
   622	- **Core Fields**: guid (string), name (string), createdAt, updatedAt
   623	- **Document**: Optional parent folder reference (self-referential)
   624	- **Optional Fields**: description, attributes
   625	- **Relationships**: Folders belong to a Kit and can have a parent Folder
   626	
   627	### Kit Contains:
   628	- Direct array embeddings: Files, Folders, Types, Designs, Tags, Concepts, Ports, Qualities, Authors
   629	- Metadata: guid, name, version, description, icon, image, preview, remote, homepage, license, createdAt, updatedAt
   630	- Diff types for change tracking
   631	
   632	### Serialization Approaches:
   633	- **Go**: JSON tag-based with `json:` tags; functions: SerializeKit/DeserializeKit
   634	- **Rust**: Serde derive with `#[serde]` attributes; Optional fields skip serialization when None
   635	- **Python**: SQLModel ORM with field mixins; parse() and dump() methods
   636	- **TypeScript**: Zod schema validation; serialize/deserialize functions use JSON.stringify/parse
   637	- **C#**: Entity classes with implicit operators; Diff types for partial updates
   638	
   639	### Database Relationships:
   640	- File has FK to Folder (optional) and Kit (required)
   641	- Folder has FK to parent Folder (optional) and Kit (required)
   642	- Kit is root entity with guid as PK
